security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Plain-text notes in an ordinary folder
bundle.longDescription: Plainfold is a desktop app for Windows and Linux that edits plain text files in a vault folder. It never renders Markdown or HTML.
